title: quercus coccinea var. tinctoria
intro: Quercus coccinea var. tinctoria, commonly known as New England red oak, is a variant of the red oak tree native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Quercus coccinea var. tinctoria include astringency and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tannins and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
